title: Understanding Ourselves and Others
text: Reflect on your own identity and heritage and explore how these influence future learning and career pathways.
cdi_links: 4.G.05 Considering what learning pathway they should pursue next

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: What self-awareness means
How culture and background influence choices
How personal values shape goals
How learning pathways connect to career ideas

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain what self-awareness means
I can identify influences on my future choices
I can describe how culture and heritage shape identity
I can recognise different learning pathways

title: Key Words
bullets: Self-awareness – Knowing your strengths, values, and personality.
Influence – How something, such as background or experiences, affects your choices.
Learning Pathway – The education or training route you choose, such as A-levels or an apprenticeship.
Cultural Identity – How your culture and background shape how you see yourself.

title: Quick Starter
text: What are some things that have helped you decide what you might want to do in the future?
Do you think your family, friends, or culture have shaped these ideas?

title: Understanding Influences
bullets: Values, family expectations, culture, and experiences shape decisions about learning and careers.
Values are the things you believe are important in life, such as helping others, earning money, or being creative.
Heritage includes your family background, culture, and traditions.

title: Examples of Influence
bullets: A student from a family of healthcare workers may feel drawn to caring professions.
A student who enjoys practical work may consider trades or apprenticeships.
A student inspired by creativity in their community may explore design, art, or media.

title: Learning Pathways
bullets: Different learning pathways suit different people.
Academic pathways include subjects studied in school or college.
Vocational pathways focus on practical skills and job training.
Work-based pathways such as apprenticeships combine work and learning.

title: Activity
text:
Reflect on your own identity and heritage.
Think about how your background, interests, and values might influence your future learning or career pathway.

title: Complete the sentence
sentence: Self-awareness helps you understand your ______ and make better ______ choices.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Understanding your identity and heritage can help you understand your place in the world
Self-awareness helps guide learning and career decisions
Different learning pathways suit different people
